# Dependency bridge pitfalls

Read before calling Expansion AI, COT or CF. Dependency calls go only through the HC bridge classes, which validate invariants and refuse with a reason code (lint HC-E022 and HC-E027). A raw `eAIGroup` handle is not auto-nulled when the group is freed: hold it through `HCXAIGroupHold` or store a group id and resolve it before every use.

Skill: `hc-dep-bridge`. Rule ids come from `tools/validate/enforce_lint.py` and `tools/validate/enforce_perf.py`; each rule or cited comment appears on exactly one card.

## Lint and perf rules

| Rule | What it rejects |
|---|---|
| HC-E022 | Expansion AI call outside HCXExpansionBridge.c (dependency invariant boundary) |
| HC-E027 | COT/CF/ExpansionStatic call outside its owned dependency bridge |
